measurement: Warm Memory Checkout p50/p95 at several store sizes, interleaved within one process against one store per size, warmup rounds discarded. Absolute latency is hardware- and load-dependent; the scaling shape is the comparable part. Cold start is not measured here.
scaling_note: p50 grew 2.48x while the store grew 16x (500 -> 8000 events). This lane measured up to 8000 events and makes no claim beyond that size.
